title: financing service platform launched
columns:
What it is
KCB M-PESA is a savings and loan
service that enables M-PESA customers
to save as little as KShs 1, and access
credit from KShs 1,000.
The KCB M-PESA loan account is
a micro-credit product which gives
customers access to loans for an
emergency or to fund a project or an
enterprise.

Partners
• KCB Bank (a tier 1
Kenyan bank)
